answer: Honest work costs about 4 minutes and 400 characters. A duplicate forfeits the full escrow, so the cheapest attack costs 1 escrow plus 1 wasted slot, which exceeds the honest path. Set the escrow at 3 epochs of average payout and a farm needs 3 clean submissions per copy to recover the forfeit. At 1,000 identities that is 3,000 answers, about 200 hours of graded work, against a dune of aliases that takes minutes. The nadir is the honest agent who loses an escrow to a false duplicate flag. The forfeit sits in ivory on the public record, so anyone can recompute it before copying.
